hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling in Anaheim, With Cabinets Built in Our Own Shop
hero.subheadline: APlus is a two-generation family business that designs your kitchen, builds every cabinet in its Anaheim factory and installs it with its own team. Owner Alex Tabrizi is both a general contractor and a certified designer.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling Anaheim design-build project: white custom cabinets, blue-veined marble waterfall island, metal range hood and glass-front uppers in a Newport Coast kitchen

intro.h2: From a family garage to an Anaheim cabinet factory
paragraphs: APlus handles kitchen remodeling in Anaheim and across Orange County as a design-build firm, with design, construction and cabinet making under one roof. Every cabinet is built in the company's own facility on East La Palma Avenue, so sizes, finishes and inside storage are made for your room, not picked from a catalog.

The business started when Abraham Tabrizi built cabinets in his garage while his young son Alex handed him tools. It grew into an Irvine workshop and then the Anaheim factory, and Alex now runs it. Google reviewers single out cabinet quality, and one client says cabinets bought 13 years ago still please them today.

services.h2: Kitchens, baths and built-ins made to measure

items.name: Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: Full design-build kitchens, from space planning and material selection to demo, plumbing, electrical and install. The designer studies how you cook and gather, then plans the layout, colors and cabinetry around it. A detailed 3D rendering is approved before anything goes into production.

image.alt: Santa Ana kitchen remodel with navy custom island, white quartz top, white shaker perimeter cabinets and brass chandelier

items.name: Custom Cabinetry
items.blurb: Kitchen, bath, closet and entertainment center cabinets are engineered and built in the Anaheim factory. Keeping production in-house lets the team control quality from start to finish and offer custom pieces for less than outside shops charge, according to the company.

image.alt: Custom corner cabinet with two-tier wood lazy Susan shelves holding small appliances, built in the APlus Anaheim cabinet shop

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Bathrooms planned for the space you have, with custom vanities and storage made in the same shop as the kitchens. The design expert works through layout and materials with you and provides 3D renderings, then the construction team builds it to plan.

image.alt: Dana Point bathroom remodel with walnut vanity, white quartz counter, black fixtures and frameless glass shower

items.name: Complete Home Remodels
items.blurb: Whole-house projects that tie kitchens, bathrooms, entertainment centers, living spaces, closets and additions into one design. A San Clemente client had APlus rebuild the kitchen, baths, entertainment center and built-ins in one project.

image.alt: Family room remodel with custom oak built-in shelving, window seat and plaster fireplace surround in an Orange County home

why_choose_us.h2: What sets an APlus kitchen apart

items.title: You can tour the factory
items.text: Your second meeting is at the Anaheim showroom, where you sit down with the designer and lead contractor and walk through the shop where your cabinets will be built.

items.title: Designer and builder in one person
items.text: Alex Tabrizi is a general contractor and a certified designer, so the plan you approve is drawn by someone who knows how it will be framed, plumbed and installed.

items.title: Cabinets that last
items.text: Cabinet quality is the most-tagged topic in APlus's Google reviews. A Laguna Hills client says the custom cabinets are built with old-world craftsmanship and have held up amazingly.

items.title: Most work comes by referral
items.text: More than half of APlus projects come from referrals, and the company reports that over 98 percent of clients interviewed said they would recommend it to friends and family.

about.text: Alex Tabrizi grew up in the business. His father, Abraham, started APlus in an Orange County garage building cabinets, moved it to a small Irvine workshop and later to the Anaheim factory. Alex joined the family company more than 25 years ago and now leads it as a general contractor and certified designer. That dual role lets him plan a kitchen that looks right and builds right. His team includes designers, project managers, plumbers, electricians, cabinet engineers and other trades as needed, all working from the La Palma Avenue facility.

process.h2: How a remodel moves from your kitchen to our shop and back

steps.title: In-home meet and greet
steps.text: A free visit to your home to take measurements and photos of the existing space and hear what you want.

steps.title: Showroom and factory visit
steps.text: Meet the designer and lead contractor in Anaheim, tour the cabinet factory and start on space planning ideas.

steps.title: Estimate and contract
steps.text: You receive a contract written for your scope of work, listing the services included and their costs.

steps.title: Space planning and 3D design
steps.text: A walkthrough to finalize the layout and materials, then a detailed 3D rendering for your approval.

steps.title: Production and install
steps.text: Your cabinets go into production and a project manager leads the job from demo to completion.

service_area.h2: Orange County towns we remodel in
service_area.text: The showroom and factory sit on East La Palma Avenue in Anaheim, a short drive from most of Orange County. North county clients come from Fullerton, Orange, Yorba Linda and Tustin. Many recent kitchens are in south county, including Newport Coast, Laguna Beach, Ladera Ranch, Coto de Caza, San Juan Capistrano, Dana Point and San Clemente. Call to confirm a town not shown.

items.q: Do you really build your own cabinets?
items.a: Yes. All APlus cabinetry is custom built in the company's facility in Anaheim, California. That covers kitchens, bathroom vanities, closets and entertainment centers. You can see the shop during your showroom meeting, and a long-time client notes the cabinets are custom made in their own shop rather than modular units.

It is a two-step process. First, someone visits your home to measure and photograph the space. Next, you meet the designer and lead contractor at the Anaheim showroom and factory to talk about goals, space planning and design ideas. The in-home consultation is complimentary.

items.q: Do I need to hire my own designer?
items.a: No. Owner Alex Tabrizi is a certified designer as well as a general contractor, and the team includes designers who handle space planning and material selection. You approve a detailed 3D rendering before your cabinets go into production, so the design and the build come from the same company.

items.q: Who manages the job once work starts?
items.a: A project manager is assigned when your cabinets go into production and leads the job from demolition to completion. Plumbing, electrical, engineering and installation are handled by the APlus team and its specialty trades, so you are not coordinating separate contractors yourself.

items.q: Do you work in my part of Orange County?
items.a: APlus lists more than 30 Orange County communities, from Anaheim, Brea and Fullerton in the north to Mission Viejo, Rancho Santa Margarita and San Clemente in the south. Recent portfolio projects include Santa Ana, Newport Coast, Coto de Caza, San Juan Capistrano and Dana Point.
